title: Aged murine bone marrow myeloid and mesenchymal cells develop unique senescence phenotypes
why_chosen: Theme 1+3+7 hit: paired CyTOF in same mouse shows MSC p16 +170% vs myeloid; LysM-Cre × p16-LOX-ATTAC clearance fails to rescue bone (myeloid repopulates fast, no BCL2 surge, no YAP/TAZ loss, no cGAS/STING). Directly questions D+Q substrate identity in BM.
